description: Ministry of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations - Collective Agreements - De La Rue Lanka Currency & Security Print (Pvt.) Limited vs. Inter Company Employees Union and South Asia Gateway Terminals Private Limited vs. Inter Company Employees Union (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a Collective Agreement under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It establishes legal terms and conditions for employment, including salary revisions, bonus payments, allowances, medical benefits, and leave policies. The agreement is published in accordance with statutory authority (Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act), making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
